actions.reasoning: Green flags: Site uses HTTPS, page design looks professional and consistent, content describes insurance services and shows sample rates. Red flags: No visible company registration or privacy policy link on the landing view provided, domain is not a well-known incumbent insurer (could be a comparison service), and I cannot verify licensing or third-party reviews from this page alone. Because the site will likely request moderately sensitive data (email, DOB, address) and possibly highly sensitive data later, proceed cautiously: provide only medium-tier PII if needed and do not submit SSN, full card numbers, bank credentials, or passwords unless additional trust signals (privacy policy, clear licensing, reputable third-party links) appear on the subsequent pages. If the form requests SSN/payment, I will pause and reassess.
